postconditions.description: The number of characters n is between 1 and 100,000.
The number of known relationships m is between 0 and 100,000.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i, b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for i in range(m))
postconditions.description: Each pair of characters a_i and b_i is labeled with an integer between 1 and n, and they are not the same character.

postconditions.expression: all(c_i in {0, 1} for i in range(m))
postconditions.description: Each relationship is labeled with either 0 (hate) or 1 (love).

postconditions.expression: all(a_i != b_i for i in range(m))
postconditions.description: No pair describes the same relationship more than once.
